File Information
Collection: Notion API - Pages
Environment: Notion Pages
Collection Description
Automated API tests for the Notion Pages module (Notion-Version 2025-09-03). 157 test cases in five folders, one per endpoint. **Scope** - POST /v1/pages (45), GET /v1/pages/{page_id} (21), GET /v1/pages/{page_id}/properties/{property_id} (23), POST /v1/pages/{page_id}/move (28) and PATCH /v1/pages/{page_id} (40). - The E2E flows of the test case document (TC_E2E_001 to TC_E2E_016) and the cases listed as not automated in the report are not part of this collection. **Conventions** - One folder per endpoint, in the same order as the test case document. - Each request is named exactly like its test case (`TC_ID: Verify that ...`). - Preconditions go in the pre-request script, assertions and cleanup go in the Post-response script. - The checks shared by every request (preconditions created, Content-Type and response time) live in the collection-level Post-response script. Each request only keeps the checks of its own case (status code, body, schema and data integrity). - A case that needs an optional variable that is empty is not sent and is reported as skipped with `pm.test.skip`, so it does not count as passed. Some other cases run an extra check only when an optional variable has a value. - Every script runs inside an async function and wraps `pm.sendRequest` in a Promise, so the collection runs both in the Postman app and in Newman. - Cleanup moves every created page to the trash (`in_trash: true`) inside a `finally` block. **Setup** 1. Import the `Notion Pages` environment and select it. 2. Fill the required variables `notionToken` (internal integration token) and `rootPageId` (a page shared with that integration). `apiBaseURL` (https://api.notion.com) and `notionVersion` (2025-09-03) already have a value. 3. Optional variables, which enable extra cases: `userId` (a workspace user), `unsharedPageId` (a page not shared with the integration), `tokenReadOnly` (integration with read content only), `tokenInsertOnly` (integration with insert content only), `revokedToken` (a revoked token) and `statusDataSourceId` (a data source with a status property). 4. Every token variable is of type secret, so the value is masked in the app and in screenshots. **Execution** - Postman Runner with the `Notion Pages` environment and a delay of 400 ms between requests (rate limit of about 3 requests per second). - Command line: `newman run Notion_Pages.postman_collection.json -e Notion_Pages.postman_environment.json --delay-request 400 --timeout-script 600000 -r cli,htmlextra`
